reports.title: Pool 13, Mississippi River (Jackson) fishing report
reports.text:
Black Crappie - Slow: Use a small jig and plastic combination or a live minnow rig in backwater areas with woody structure.
Largemouth Bass - Fair: Use spinnerbaits or in-line spinners along vegetation lines in backwater areas or along areas with rip-rap.
Smallmouth Bass - Fair: Throw inline spinners or crankbaits along rocky areas with some current/current breaks.
White Crappie - Slow: Try a three-way rig with live bait on the wing-dams or in the tailwaters. Look for walleye fishing to improve as the water temperature continues to drop.

reports.title: Lake Delhi (Delaware) fishing report
reports.text: Black Crappie - Fair: Cast and retrieve jig and plastics or a live minnow under a slip bobber near structure along the shorelines in 8-10 feet of water..

reports.title: Brushy Creek Lake (Webster) fishing report
reports.text: Black Crappie - Fair: Find crappie near submerged structure in 5-15 feet of water..

reports.title: Lake Belva Deer (Keokuk) fishing report
reports.text: Largemouth Bass - Fair: Bass are starting to spend more time in shallower water feeding as the bluegills come in. Try crawdad imitations along the rocks and "minnow" crankbaits along the edges of the trees.

reports.title: Lake Darling (Washington) fishing report
reports.text: Largemouth Bass - Fair: Bass fishing is picking up as they follow the bluegills into shallower water.Work the rip-rap with crawdad imitations as they feed on them.

reports.title: Lost Grove Lake (Scott) fishing report
reports.text: Largemouth Bass - Fair: Anglers are catching bass at the outlet of the causeway as they wait for food to be washed through there. Work the edges of the weed beds near deeper water on the main body of the lake by flipping jigs with crawdad trailers back into them.

reports.title: Coralville Reservoir (Johnson) fishing report
reports.text:
Black Crappie - Fair: Fishing has been day to day; anglers are catching fish with minnows or soft plastics.
White Crappie - Fair: Fishing has been day to day; anglers are catching fish with minnows or soft plastics.

reports.title: Iowa Lake (Iowa Co.) (Iowa) fishing report
reports.text:
Black Crappie - Good: Use 3 inch silver or black twister tails in brush piles in 6-8 feet of water in the mornings.
Largemouth Bass - Good: Use jerk baits, chatter baits or square bill crankbaits in 8-10 feet of water in the mornings. Anglers are catching some on topwater in the mornings or evenings.

reports.title: Hickory Grove Lake (Story) fishing report
reports.text: Black Crappie - Fair: Try vertical jigging or slowly trolling small plastics over habitat. Afternoons and early evening bite is best.

reports.title: Little River Watershed Lake (Decatur) fishing report
reports.text: Largemouth Bass - Fair: Catch Largemouth Bass of all sizes using crankbaits fished along rocky shoreline areas.

reports.title: Pleasant Creek Lake (Linn) fishing report
reports.text: Black Crappie - Good: Crappies are holding tight to brush piles; use minnows.

reports.title: Lake Sugema (Van Buren) fishing report
reports.text:
Black Crappie - Slow: Target suspended crappies with small crankbaits or small jigs. As the water cools, crappies should start to gather around brush piles and other submerged structures.
Largemouth Bass - Fair: Use crankbaits or plastics around the rock jetties and other rip-rapped shorelines.

reports.title: Lake Wapello (Davis) fishing report
reports.text: Largemouth Bass - Fair: Use crankbaits and plastics or spinnerbaits along brush piles and rocky shorelines.

reports.title: Rathbun Reservoir (Appanoose) fishing report
reports.text: Black Crappie - Slow: Target suspended crappie with small crankbaits. Look for crappies to gather around brush piles and be closer to shore as the water cools.

reports.title: Farm Creek Lake (a.k.a. Young's Pond) (Pottawattamie) fishing report
reports.text:
Black Crappie - Fair: Anglers are catching black crappie off the jetty on the west side of the lake.
Largemouth Bass - Fair: Farm Creek has a good largemouth bass population.

reports.title: Greenfield Lake (Adair) fishing report
reports.text:
Black Crappie - Fair: Slow troll open water areas to find schools of black crappie.
Largemouth Bass - Fair: Greenfield has a high percentage of 12- to 14-inch largemouth bass.

reports.title: Lake Anita (Cass) fishing report
reports.text:
Black Crappie - Good: Troll the roadbeds or fish along deep tree piles to find black crappies. Sorting is needed for larger fish.
Largemouth Bass - Fair: Bass anglers are finding fish in deep tree piles and along the roadbed.

reports.title: Meadow Lake (Adair) fishing report
reports.text:
Black Crappie - Fair: Look for black crappies in the tree piles. Late afternoon bite is best.
Largemouth Bass - Status Unsure: N/A

reports.title: Prairie Rose Lake (Shelby) fishing report
reports.text:
Black Crappie - Fair: Find black crappies in the tree piles. Fish will average 9.5-inches. Anglers are trolling for larger fish.
Largemouth Bass - Fair: N/A

reports.title: Viking Lake (Montgomery) fishing report
reports.text:
Black Crappie - Good: Look for 9-inch black crappies in the tree piles.
Largemouth Bass - Fair: Boat anglers are finding largemouth bass in shallow tree piles.

reports.text:
Black Crappie - Fair: Use a small jig and plastic combination or a live minnow rig in side channel areas with woody structure.
Largemouth Bass - Fair: Use spinnerbaits or in-line spinners along vegetation lines in backwater areas or along areas with rip-rap.
White Crappie - Slow: Use a small jig and plastic combination or a live minnow rig in side channel areas with woody structure.

reports.title: Pool 09, Mississippi River (Allamakee) fishing report
reports.text:
Largemouth Bass - Good: Largemouth fall feeding is underway. Cast plastics or buzz-baits along thick vegetation in upper portions of backwaters..
Smallmouth Bass - Excellent: Smallmouth bass are prepping for winter and actively feeding along main channel. Use inline spinner-baits along rip-rap.

reports.title: Cedar River (above Nashua) (Floyd) fishing report
reports.text:
Black Crappie - Fair: Find crappie near snags in backwater areas. Try a small spinner or crankbait.
Smallmouth Bass - Fair: Find smallmouth along rocky shorelines or limestone ledges as they move to deeper water. Try a variety of lures.

reports.title: Turkey River (above Clermont) (Fayette) fishing report
reports.text: Smallmouth Bass - Fair: Find smallmouth along rocky shorelines or limestone ledges as they move to deeper water. Try a variety of lures.

reports.text: Smallmouth Bass - Fair: Find smallmouth along rocky shorelines or limestone ledges as they move to deeper water. Try a variety of lures.

reports.title: Upper Iowa River (below Decorah) (Allamakee) fishing report
reports.text: Smallmouth Bass - Fair: Find smallmouth along rocky shorelines or limestone ledges as they move to deeper water. Try a variety of lures.

reports.title: Clear Lake (Cerro Gordo) fishing report
reports.text: Black Crappie - Slow: Anglers are catching crappie off the docks with small jigs around the boat hoists.

reports.title: Crystal Lake (Hancock) fishing report
reports.text: Black Crappie - Good: Drift fish or troll crappie jigs in 8-12 feet of water.

reports.title: Big Hollow Lake (Des Moines) fishing report
reports.text: Black Crappie - Slow: Try vertical jigging with a minnow trailer or slip bobber and minnow in about 7 - 8 feet of water along and in the trees along the south side of the lake. Crappie are waiting for Fall..

reports.title: Lake Geode (Henry) fishing report
reports.text: Black Crappie - Fair: Crappies continue to remain out over the fish habitat in 8 to 10 feet of water, just out from the steeper banks. Expect them to move in closer to the edges of the water willow beds when the rains stop.

reports.title: Big Creek Lake (Polk) fishing report
reports.text: Black Crappie - Fair: Try trolling or jigging panfish plastics over roadbeds and brush piles in water less than 15 feet deep. Shore anglers can try the rock fishing jetties in the early mornings and evenings.

reports.title: Lake Hendricks (Howard) fishing report
reports.text:
Black Crappie - Good: Find crappie along weedlines. Try a small spinner or crankbait.
Largemouth Bass - Fair: Toss a topwater lure along the edge of a plant bed or rocky shoreline. Keep tension on the line to prevent losing your lure.

reports.title: Lake Macbride (Johnson) fishing report
reports.text: White Crappie - Good: Some days are better than others; anglers report improvements in crappie fishing this week. Use jigs tipped with plastics or minnows around brush piles or aquatic vegetation. Most fish are 9- to 12-inches with larger fish up to 16-inches.

reports.title: East Okoboji Lake (Dickinson) fishing report
reports.text: Black Crappie - Good: Anglers have been able to target quality size fish..
